hooks.command: bash -c 'echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE "wrangler (deploy|publish)" && echo "[hook] REMINDER: Run lint before deploying: cd web && npm run lint" || true'

bash -c 'FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"file_path\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "workers/src/" && echo "[hook] Worker file modified — verify write pipeline order: R2 receipt → R2 canonical → D1" || true'
